title: Creamy leeks and mushrooms on toast with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Butter, leeks, mushrooms, crème fraîche, mustard, eggs and bread are all ordinary kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a saucepan and a toaster or grill, and poaching eggs is within a confident beginner's reach.

works.reason: Two leeks and 250g of mushrooms with crème fraîche, four eggs and four slices of toast make a sensible breakfast for four, and the timings are sound.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is enough to wash and slice the leeks and mushrooms, poach the eggs and make the toast, and the 10 minute cook matches the frying step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, nothing unlisted is used apart from water, and wholemeal bread fits the bread id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Leeks are the bulk of the topping and a warm savoury breakfast suits early April.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, vegetables and wholemeal toast make a filling, real-food breakfast a family would happily repeat.
